prompt:
Base rules. A change that breaks any of these is rejected before scoring:
1. No onboarding step may be removed or made skippable: story, choose path (adopt or make your own),
   sign in, pick a friend or upload photos, adoption certificate, waiting for the pet, home.
   Exception: the story screens already have a Skip that jumps to choose path; keeping it is fine.
2. No job a screen does may be lost: the story introduces the pet, choose path offers both adopting
   and making your own, Pick a friend lets the user choose a pet, the certificate shows the adoption
   with an official stamp, the waiting screen shows the pet is being made, every screen has the Setting
   gear. Any design may be replaced by a better one, as long as it still does the same job.
3. Pricing stays as it is: the first adoption is free and later adoptions are paid. Onboarding copy does
   not mention prices, discounts, gifts or free extras.
4. Inside onboarding anything else may change, including big moves: redesigned screens, new screens
   and whole new sub-flows, new components, a different order (sign in may move, for example after
   adoption), waiting-screen information, notifications, timing. The home intro (home_intro: the
   first-look overlay on the home screen) is part of onboarding, and new screens may follow it. Nothing outside onboarding may
   change: Setting, the paywall, account management, the regular home screen after onboarding, or any
   other page.
5. Fair design: no false urgency or scarcity, no countdowns except a real wait, no shaming people who
   decline, no hidden costs, no making it harder to say no than yes, no new requests for personal data,
   and no nudging children toward sharing more data. (FTC dark-patterns report; EU DSA Art. 25; EU AI
   Act Art. 5; UK Age Appropriate Design Code, standard 13.)

Check each proposed change against the base rules. Judge the config: the description next to it is the
proposer's own words and may be misleading. Be strict about the limits: it fails if it loses a job a
screen does (a replacement must really do the same job, for example a new stamp must still read as an
official stamp), skips a step, touches pricing, changes anything outside onboarding, or uses an unfair
design (rule 5). Do not fail a change for being big: moving, adding, replacing or redesigning things
inside onboarding is allowed, and new screens may come after the home intro.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "pass": true or false, "rule": rule number or null, "reason": short}]}

Changes (with their configs):
0: [adoption, redesign] Preset Pet Quick Select Stage: Redesign the friend selection screen into a stage layout featuring direct choice cards for quick preset selection.
   config: {"pick_friend": {"layout": "stage", "headline": "Choose Your Ready Pet", "body": "Select a pre-made pet companion to jump straight into desktop setup without waiting.", "replace": {"pet_choices": [{"role": "pet_choices", "type": "choice_cards", "label": "Preset Companions", "style": "playful"}]}}}
1: [home, new_screen] Asset Generation Progress Stage: Insert a dedicated progress screen right before waiting to display explicit asset preparation status.
   config: {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "sign_in", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "new_asset_prep", "waiting", "home_intro"], "new_asset_prep": {"headline": "Compiling Pet Sprites", "body": "We are preparing your pet's desktop animation assets for first launch.", "show_progress": true, "layout": "centered"}}
2: [adoption, new_flow] Instant Mascot Selection Flow: Add immediate mascot preview components directly into the pet selection screen for 1-click adoption.
   config: {"pick_friend": {"layout": "grid", "components": [{"type": "mascot", "style": "playful", "action": "choose"}, {"type": "button", "label": "Instant Select", "action": "next"}]}}
3: [sign_in, reorder] Late Sign-In Post-Adoption Shift: Move sign-in after pet adoption certificate so users build emotional connection before account creation.
   config: {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "sign_in", "waiting", "home_intro"], "sign_in": {"headline": "Save Your Companion", "body": "Sign in now to sync your new pet companion across devices."}}
4: [adoption, copy] Adoption Fast Track Copy: Update adoption certificate screen copy to emphasize fast 60-second adoption setup.
   config: {"adoption_certificate": {"headline": "Official Pet Adoption", "body": "Your pet certificate is ready! Setup will complete on your desktop in under 60 seconds.", "hint": "No complex configuration required."}}
5: [finish, hint] Desktop Display Permission Hint: Add a prominent system permission hint on the final screen explaining desktop overlay settings.
   config: {"home_intro": {"hint": "Ensure desktop display overlay permissions are granted if your pet doesn't appear immediately.", "components": [{"type": "text", "text": "Desktop Permission Note", "style": "subtle"}]}}
6: [home, wait_info] Waiting Room Timer & Animation: Add visual timer component and dynamic progress bar to the asset waiting screen.
   config: {"waiting": {"headline": "Bringing Your Pet To Life", "show_time_estimate": true, "show_progress": true, "tip_delay_seconds": 10, "components": [{"type": "timer", "style": "rounded"}, {"type": "animation", "style": "playful"}]}}
7: [home, notification] Background Preparation Alert: Enable system notification prompt on waiting screen so users can minimize while waiting.
   config: {"waiting": {"notify_when_ready": true, "body": "Feel free to minimize this window! We will alert you the moment your pet lands on your desktop."}}
8: [choose_path, incentive] Free Toy Badge Incentive: Display a bonus accessory badge on path selection screen to increase initial engagement.
   config: {"choose_path": {"headline": "Choose Your Journey", "body": "Every companion path comes with a free desktop starter toy!", "components": [{"type": "badge", "label": "Free Starter Toy Included", "style": "highlight"}]}}
9: [choose_path, layout] Split View Path Selection Layout: Switch path selection from list layout to a split two-column layout for side-by-side comparison.
   config: {"choose_path": {"layout": "split", "headline": "Pick Your Pet Style", "body": "Choose between ready preset companions or custom created pets."}}

verdicts.reason: Valid redesign of the pet selection screen within onboarding limits.
Adding a new progress screen inside onboarding is explicitly permitted.
Valid component update to the pick_friend screen preserving its core job.
Reordering sign_in to occur post-adoption is explicitly permitted under Rule 4.
Copy update on adoption certificate screen retains required functionality and rule compliance.
Adding permission hints to home_intro inside onboarding is allowed.
Adding a timer and progress bar for a real wait period on the waiting screen is permitted.
Adding notifications on the waiting screen is explicitly allowed by Rule 4.
Onboarding copy mentions free extras ('free desktop starter toy'), violating Rule 3.
Redesigning path selection layout while retaining both options is allowed.
